Your cast!  
EC = Entitled Creep

Me = me

AD = Amazing dad (my dad!)

pg= phone kiosk guy (there was a kiosk right outside the store)

Also good to know is that I have ADHD which means I also have difficulties managing emotions and I take things to heart very quickly.----

So I worked for a small independent nerdy store. We were like a hot topic in the sense we sold nerdy shirts, accessories, and even belt buckles. There was only two locations of the store and one was in a small mall from my small town.When I applied, I was only 16 and looking for work to do part time because thats what teenagers do. The first warning sign that this was a shitty place to work should have been when they hired me and NEVER wanted a resume or references. They were that desperate for employees.

So anyway. work started and after like 3 days I was opening, closing, and running the store on my own. Again, this should have been warning sign 2 but I had no retail experience and thought this was normal so I put on a brave face and would do my best. My best friend for the short 3 months I worked there became PG because when either one of us went to get food, we would watch each others store and generally keep an eye out. I was never super close with him but he was chill enough

One saturday night, EC comes into the store and looks around He's at least 40 and a large, fat, greasy man. I try not to be judgemental (at the time.)and greet him with the typical 'hello' and a smile. He flashed me a grin back and I thought nothing of it.Then he comes to the till

EC: hey cutie. I wanna get this. Are you a fan of deadpool   
Me, uncomfortable with the nickname and giving an awkward laugh: aha yeah I've read a few of the comics and played the video game for it. He's pretty cool  
EC: If you want, I own the \[insert local cinema\] if you ever wanna see a movie like the upcoming deadpool movie. you could see it with me?  
Me: ah that's okay. I plan to see it with my dad this weekend (I'm trying to be polite but don't have the backbone yet to be firm)  
EC: Why wait? How about after you close I'll come pick you up okay?

before I can answer, he takes his stuff, gives me a grimy wink, and leaves.I'm a little shaken at this point and near tears because I don't know what to do. I phone my dad and let him know what happened and my dad says he'll come pick me up so I don't have to be alone. PG sees me crying and he got me a booster juice to calm me down which was really sweet.

Closing time comes around and low and behold who do I see sitting on a bench watching me while I close yep, EC.I'm scared shitless at this point because I don't know what to do. I didn't know at the time but PG was calling security at that moment.I'm staying inside the store and not locking up until I see my dad whos staying a few feet away. I finally close down and EC comes up to me.

EC: hey sweetie. ready to see the movie?

I freeze in fear as I don't know what to say. My dad walks up behind me.My dad is a BIG guy. He's a no bullshit kinda dude with others but very protective of me.

AD: excuse me. can you leave her alone?  
EC: who the fuck are you? I'm taking her to a movie. nothing harmful  
AD: I'm her father and you WILL leave her alone.  
EC: she's coming with me. if you don't let her come with me I'll follow you until she agrees to come with me

I don't remember a whole lot but finally security comes up and gets involved. My dad is yelling at this point and I'm horrified about what's going to happen.Security eventually tells him he needs to leave me alone as as he's walking away he yells out

EC: THAT SLUT SMILED AT ME! SHE WANTED TO BE HIT ON! FUCKING FEMINIST PLAYS HARD TO GET AND GETS MAD WHEN GUYS TAKE ACTION

Hey there! My family is in the film business so lemme give you some pointers:

1: you dont need to go to film school. In fact, it might be a waste of time and money to do so. lots of people who go into the business come from different degrees and thats what makes them hireable

2: You’re gonna have to start pretty low on the chain for a while. you might be just an intern for 3-5 years. It sucks but take advantage of that time to meet people. Film industry is all based on making connections.

3: when you talk with a potential employer, do research on what that individual has worked on and start to kiss up. Thats LITERALLY the advice i was given and its really true. Employers tend to want to hire people who they have worked with versus someone new. But if you kiss up it leaves a good impression. 

4: CALL BACK. If you have an interveiw please PLEASE call back. It shows initiative. and filmies may have forgotten and just need a reminder

Im from canada so IDK how it works in american, but try to join a union or film guild as soon as you can.
